definitions.explanation: Knowledge or insights gained through experience, research, or study. Often implies practical, specialized knowledge that has been accumulated over time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門的|せんもんてき}→専門的：15633_senmonteki⟧な{知見|ちけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧。
examples.english: To make use of specialized knowledge.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{知見|ちけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Knowledge in this field is lacking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{得|え}られた→得る：02014_eru⟧{知見|ちけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}えて→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧いくこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to pass on the knowledge gained through years of research to the next generation.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word commonly used in academic, business, and technical contexts. Often appears in the pattern {知見|ちけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to gain knowledge), {知見|ちけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{共有|きょうゆう}する→共有する：19639_kyouyuusuru⟧ (to share knowledge/findings), or {知見|ちけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧ (to apply knowledge). More formal and specialized than ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧ (general knowledge).

WRITING:
{知|ち} means "to know" and {見|けん} means "to see" or "view." The compound suggests knowledge gained through observation and experience.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧: knowledge (general, broader)
- {知見|ちけん}: knowledge, findings (specialized, from experience/research)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {知見|ちけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to gain knowledge/findings
- {知見|ちけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧: to apply knowledge
- {知見|ちけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{共有|きょうゆう}する→共有する：19639_kyouyuusuru⟧: to share findings
- {知見|ちけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蓄積|ちくせき}する→蓄積する：25358_chikusekisuru⟧: to accumulate knowledge
